The observed version mismatch between pkgver and the upstream release tag is a packaging hygiene issue, not a security injection. No malicious code, network exfiltration, or execution of untrusted content is present in the PKGBUILD or .SRCINFO.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from qwen3-235b returning an 'inconclusive' verdict due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400) when attempting to audit .SRCINFO, whereas deepseek-v4-flash successfully audited all files and returned 'safe'. The openrouter/free report was marked as advisory and also returned 'safe'. The conflict is a tool failure rather than a genuine difference in security assessment.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), leading to an overall inconclusive result.
learnings: The audit orchestration layer should implement retries or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors to prevent a single file failure from forcing an overall 'inconclusive' verdict.
